theorem mvcc.memberAt_succ_key (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (N : Nat) (keys : List Loc) (i
    : Nat) (Out : GMap Loc (List mvcc.EvM)) (Bv : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch) {key : Loc} (hkey :
    keys[i]? = some key) (v : mvcc.WatcherSt) : mvcc.memberAt γ σ N keys (i + 1) Out Bv key v =
    mvcc.memberDone γ σ N key v ((Out !! key).getD []) ((Option.map mvcc.EventBatch.evs (Bv !!
    key)).getD [])

theorem mvcc.memberAt_rest (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (N : Nat) (keys : List Loc) (i :
    Nat) (Out : GMap Loc (List mvcc.EvM)) (Bv : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch) (w : Loc) (st :
    mvcc.WatcherSt) (h : ¬w ∈ List.take i keys) : mvcc.memberAt γ σ N keys i Out Bv w st =
    mvcc.memberRes γ 1 σ w st

theorem mvcc.watchEvents_next_modRev (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hne : ilog ≠ [])
    (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (ev : mvcc.EvM) : ev ∈ mvcc.watchEvents (ilog ++ [pend]) r (List.length
    ilog) (List.length ilog + 1) → ev.kv.modRev = W64 ↑(List.length ilog)

theorem mvcc.batchOf_some {W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange} {ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt} {evs : List
    mvcc.EvM} {w : Loc} {B : mvcc.EventBatch} (h : mvcc.batchOf W ST evs !! w = some B) : ∃ r st, W
    !! w = some r ∧ ST !! w = some st ∧ mvcc.memberBatch r st evs = some B

theorem mvcc.memberRes_final (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List
    mvcc.Change) (N : Nat) (hN : List.length ilog = N) (hLmu : σ.Lmu = ilog) (hne : ilog ≠ []) (hlen

    Loc (Loc × mvcc.EventBatch)) (STi : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (Wsi : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange)
    (Bv : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch) (Out : GMap Loc (List mvcc.EvM)) (PBr : GMap Loc (Loc ×
    mvcc.EventBatch)) (hkeys : ∀ (k : Loc), k ∈ keys ↔ (mvcc.batchOf σ.Ws σ.ST (mvcc.evsOfRevM N
    (mvcc.stateAfter ilog) pend) !! k).isSome = true) (hrel : mvcc.NotifyRel σ N (mvcc.batchOf σ.Ws
    σ.ST (mvcc.evsOfRevM N (mvcc.stateAfter ilog) pend)) PB keys keys.length STi Wsi Bv Out PBr)
    (vs' : GoSlice) (vm : GoMap) (k : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (hSTk : STi !! k = some st) :
    (mvcc.evLog γ.st (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗ mvcc.relLb γ (List.length (ilog ++ [pend])) ∗ [∗map] w ↦ r ∈
    Wsi, iprop(∃ fcs, mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs)) ∗ mvcc.memberAt γ σ N keys keys.length Out Bv k st
    ⊢ mvcc.memberRes γ 1 (mvcc.notifyState σ N STi Wsi Bv Out vs' vm) k st

theorem mvcc.memberBatch_one_rev (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (m : Nat) (hm : m < 2 ^
    63) (hmin : sint.Z st.minRev ≤ ↑m) (evs acc : List mvcc.EvM) : (∀ (e : mvcc.EvM), e ∈ evs →
    e.kv.modRev = W64 ↑m) → (∀ (e : mvcc.EvM), e ∈ acc → e.kv.modRev = W64 ↑m) → List.foldl (fun ob
    ev => if (r.covers ev.kv.key && decide (sint.Z st.minRev ≤ sint.Z ev.kv.modRev)) = true then
    some (mvcc.ebAdd (ob.getD mvcc.EventBatch.empty) ev) else ob) (if acc = [] then none else some {
    evs := acc, revs := W64 1, moreRev := W64 0 }) evs = if acc ++ List.filter (fun ev => r.covers
    ev.kv.key) evs = [] then none else some { evs := acc ++ List.filter (fun ev => r.covers
    ev.kv.key) evs, revs := W64 1, moreRev := W64 0 }

    (hN1 : N + 1 < 2 ^ 63) (Bt : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch) (hBtWs : ∀ (k : Loc), (Bt !! k).isSome =

    : GMap Loc (Loc × mvcc.EventBatch)) (hrel : mvcc.NotifyRel σ N Bt PB keys keys.length STi Wsi Bv
    Out PBr) (vs' : GoSlice) (vm : GoMap) (hvo : ∀ (k : Loc), (mvcc.notifyState σ N STi Wsi Bv Out
    vs' vm).victimOf k = (σ.victimOf k).or (Bv !! k)) : (mvcc.notifyState σ N STi Wsi Bv Out vs'
    vm).syncedBelow (N + 1) ∧ (mvcc.notifyState σ N STi Wsi Bv Out vs' vm).vicBelow (N + 1)

theorem mvcc.evsOfRevM_modRev (N : Nat) (before : List EtcdKv) (hs : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess
    before) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (ev : mvcc.EvM) : ev ∈ mvcc.evsOfRevM N before cs → ev.kv.modRev
    = W64 ↑N

theorem mvcc.std_delete_eq {V : Type} (m : GMap Loc V) (k : Loc) : Std.delete m k = GMap.delete k m

theorem mvcc.memberRes_synced (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (q : Qp) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (w : Loc) (st :
    mvcc.WatcherSt) (hW : (σ.Ws !! w).isSome = true) : mvcc.memberRes γ q σ w st ⊢ ∃ γw r fcs evsw
    d, ⌜σ.M !! w = some γw⌝ ∗ mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗ mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗ mvcc.watcherChan
    γ w γw st.ch ∗ mvcc.filtersOk fcs ∗ ⌜sint.Z r.startRev ≤ ↑γw.lo⌝ ∗ ⌜σ.E !! w = some (evsw, d)⌝ ∗
    monoListAuthOwn γw.evs q.half evsw ∗ dghostVar γw.live (DFrac.own q.half) true ∗ ⌜↑γw.lo ≤
    sint.Z st.minRev ∧ sint.Z st.minRev ≤ ↑d⌝ ∗ mvcc.evsWf γ r γw.lo evsw d

def mvcc.memberDone (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (N : Nat) (w : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt)
    (evsw ext : List mvcc.EvM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γw r fcs,
      ⌜σ.M !! w = some γw⌝ ∗
        mvcc.watcherMeta γ w γw ∗
          mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗
            mvcc.watcherChan γ w γw st.ch ∗
              mvcc.filtersOk fcs ∗
                ⌜sint.Z r.startRev ≤ ↑γw.lo⌝ ∗
                  monoListAuthOwn γw.evs (Qp.half 1) evsw ∗
                    dghostVar γw.live (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) true ∗
                      ⌜↑γw.lo ≤ sint.Z st.minRev ∧ sint.Z st.minRev = ↑N + 1⌝ ∗
                        mvcc.evsWf γ r γw.lo (evsw ++ ext) (N + 1))

structure mvcc.NotifyRel (σ : mvcc.WsState) (N : Nat) (Bt : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch)
  (PB : GMap Loc (Loc × mvcc.EventBatch)) (keys : List Loc) (i : Nat) (STi : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt)
  (Wsi : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (Bv : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch) (Out : GMap Loc (List mvcc.EvM))
  (PBr : GMap Loc (Loc × mvcc.EventBatch)) : Prop where
  st_rest : STi !! k = σ.ST !! k
  st_done : ∃ st,
  σ.ST !! k = some st ∧
    STi !! k =
      some
        { minRev := W64 (↑N + 1), victim := (Bv !! k).isSome, compacted := st.compacted, restore := st.restore,
          ch := st.ch }
  ws : Wsi !! k = if (Bv !! k).isSome = true then none else σ.Ws !! k
  bv : k ∈ List.take i keys ∧ Bt !! k = some B
  out : (Out !! k).isSome = true ↔ k ∈ List.take i keys
  pbr : PBr !! k = if k ∈ List.take i keys then none else PB !! k
  lo_done : γw.lo ≤ N + 1

theorem mvcc.bigSepM_step {V : Type} {Φ Ψ : Loc → V → IProp GF} (m : GMap Loc V) (w : Loc) (y : V)
    (h : ∀ (k : Loc) (v : V), k ≠ w → Φ k v ⊢ Ψ k v) : ([∗map] k ↦ v ∈ Std.delete m w, Φ k v) ∗ Ψ w
    y ⊢ [∗map] k ↦ v ∈ <[w := y]>m, Ψ k v

theorem mvcc.memberBatch_none_of_gt (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (m : Nat) (hm : m <
    2 ^ 63) (hgt : ↑m < sint.Z st.minRev) (evs : List mvcc.EvM) (acc : Option mvcc.EventBatch) : (∀
    (e : mvcc.EvM), e ∈ evs → e.kv.modRev = W64 ↑m) → List.foldl (fun ob ev => if (r.covers
    ev.kv.key && decide (sint.Z st.minRev ≤ sint.Z ev.kv.modRev)) = true then some (mvcc.ebAdd
    (ob.getD mvcc.EventBatch.empty) ev) else ob) acc evs = acc

def mvcc.notifyState (σ : mvcc.WsState) (N : Nat) (STi : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (Wsi : GMap Loc
    mvcc.WatchRange) (Bv : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch) (Out : GMap Loc (List mvcc.EvM)) (vs' :
    GoSlice) (vm : GoMap) : mvcc.WsState :=
  { Lmu := σ.Lmu, Ws := Wsi, Wu := σ.Wu, ST := STi, Wo := σ.Wo, M := σ.M,
    E :=
      mvcc.gmapMapK
        (fun k e =>
          match Out !! k with
          | some ev => (ev, N + 1)
          | none =>
            if (σ.Ws !! k).isSome = true then (e.fst, max ((Option.map mvcc.WatcherNames.lo (σ.M !! k)).getD 0) (N + 1))
            else e)
        σ.E,
    vs := vs', vbs := if Bv.size = 0 then σ.vbs else σ.vbs ++ [vm], VB := if Bv.size = 0 then σ.VB else σ.VB ++ [Bv] }

theorem mvcc.NotifyRel.step {σ : mvcc.WsState} {N : Nat} {Bt : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch} {PB : GMap
    Loc (Loc × mvcc.EventBatch)} {keys : List Loc} {i : Nat} {STi : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt} {Wsi :
    GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange} {Bv : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch} {Out : GMap Loc (List mvcc.EvM)} {PBr
    : GMap Loc (Loc × mvcc.EventBatch)} (h : mvcc.NotifyRel σ N Bt PB keys i STi Wsi Bv Out PBr)
    {key : Loc} (hkey : keys[i]? = some key) (hnot : ¬key ∈ List.take i keys) {stw : mvcc.WatcherSt}
    (hST : σ.ST !! key = some stw) {B : mvcc.EventBatch} (hBt : Bt !! key = some B) (hBv : Bv !! key
    = none) (vic : Bool) (e : List mvcc.EvM) (hlo : ∀ (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames), σ.M !! key = some γw
    → γw.lo ≤ N + 1) : mvcc.NotifyRel σ N Bt PB keys (i + 1) (<[key :=
      { minRev := W64 (↑N + 1), victim := vic, compacted := stw.compacted, restore := stw.restore, ch := stw.ch }]>STi)
    (if vic = true then GMap.delete key Wsi else Wsi) (if vic = true then <[key := B]>Bv else Bv) (<[key := e]>Out)
    (GMap.delete key PBr)

theorem mvcc.notify_batch (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hne : ilog ≠ []) (hlen :
    List.length ilog < 2 ^ 63) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (hmin : sint.Z st.minRev
    ≤ ↑(List.length ilog)) : mvcc.memberBatch r st (mvcc.evsOfRevM (List.length ilog)
    (mvcc.stateAfter ilog) pend) = if mvcc.watchEvents (ilog ++ [pend]) r (List.length ilog)
    (List.length ilog + 1) = [] then none else some { evs := mvcc.watchEvents (ilog ++ [pend]) r
    (List.length ilog) (List.length ilog + 1), revs := W64 1, moreRev := W64 0 }

theorem mvcc.batched_member (σ : mvcc.WsState) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hne :
    ilog ≠ []) (hlen : List.length ilog < 2 ^ 63) (hok : mvcc.WsOk σ) (hLmu : σ.Lmu = ilog) (hbelow
    : σ.syncedBelow (List.length ilog)) {w : Loc} {r : mvcc.WatchRange} {st : mvcc.WatcherSt} {γw :
    mvcc.WatcherNames} {evsw : List mvcc.EvM} {d : Nat} {B : mvcc.EventBatch} (hW : (σ.Ws !!
    w).isSome = true) (hM : σ.M !! w = some γw) (hE : σ.E !! w = some (evsw, d)) (hlo : ↑γw.lo ≤
    sint.Z st.minRev) (hmd : sint.Z st.minRev ≤ ↑d) (hB : mvcc.memberBatch r st (mvcc.evsOfRevM
    (List.length ilog) (mvcc.stateAfter ilog) pend) = some B) : sint.Z st.minRev ≤ ↑(List.length
    ilog) ∧ γw.lo ≤ List.length ilog ∧ d = List.length ilog ∧ mvcc.watchEvents (ilog ++ [pend]) r
    (List.length ilog) (List.length ilog + 1) ≠ [] ∧ B = { evs := mvcc.watchEvents (ilog ++ [pend])
    r (List.length ilog) (List.length ilog + 1), revs := W64 1, moreRev := W64 0 }

theorem mvcc.batchOf_none {W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange} {ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt} {evs : List
    mvcc.EvM} {w : Loc} {r : mvcc.WatchRange} {st : mvcc.WatcherSt} (hW : W !! w = some r) (hS : ST
    !! w = some st) (h : mvcc.batchOf W ST evs !! w = none) : mvcc.memberBatch r st evs = none

theorem mvcc.memberAt_succ_ne (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (N : Nat) (keys : List Loc) (i :
    Nat) (Out Out' : GMap Loc (List mvcc.EvM)) (Bv Bv' : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch) {key : Loc} (hkey
    : keys[i]? = some key) (k : Loc) (hk : k ≠ key) (hO : Out' !! k = Out !! k) (hB : Bv' !! k = Bv
    !! k) (v : mvcc.WatcherSt) : mvcc.memberAt γ σ N keys (i + 1) Out' Bv' k v = mvcc.memberAt γ σ N
    keys i Out Bv k v

def mvcc.memberAt (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (N : Nat) (keys : List Loc) (i : Nat) (Out :
    GMap Loc (List mvcc.EvM)) (Bv : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch) (w : Loc) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) :
    IProp GF :=
  if w ∈ List.take i keys then
    mvcc.memberDone γ σ N w st ((Out !! w).getD []) ((Option.map mvcc.EventBatch.evs (Bv !! w)).getD [])
  else mvcc.memberRes γ 1 σ w st
